title: wallet request checks
property: checkRequest (a fresh wallet per case, so the date log is empty) either returns the verifier's registered KEM key or throws WalletRefusal naming a WALLET_CHECKS check; it returns only for a request that the reference accepts and that names this chain, the registered verifier, a standard threshold, an allowed type and an acceptable date; present() on a Proxy or a throwing getter refuses with requestShape before any other check

slow.basis: max(1000 ms, 100 x median call time of the first 200 cases); not a timing result

callTimeMs.note: time of the call(s) under test, for the slow-input detector only; not a timing result (untimed series, no quiet-machine protocol)
